verdict.rationale: pnpm ships a first-party `pnpm audit` command that checks installed packages for known security issues, supports `--fix` to auto-remediate, and documents workflow for overriding vulnerable versions via pnpm-workspace.yaml overrides — clearly delivering CLI-based vulnerability auditing. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on community corroboration of `pnpm audit` usage or its accuracy, and no detail on vulnerability database source/coverage.
